definitions.explanation: A performer of manzai, a traditional form of Japanese stand-up comedy performed by a duo consisting of a straight man (tsukkomi) and a funny man (boke).

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{漫才師|まんざいし}。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{漫才師|まんざいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}していた→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: He aspired to be a manzai comedian from a young age.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{漫才師|まんざいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦{合|あ}っていて→合う：10466_au⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かせる→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: That manzai duo has perfect chemistry and always gets the audience fired up.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧ (manzai comedy) and {師|し} (master, practitioner). Refers to professional performers of manzai, a distinctly Japanese form of rapid-fire comic dialogue.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Manzai is a form of stand-up comedy especially associated with Osaka and the Kansai region. It features a two-person act: the ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧ (funny man) delivers absurd or silly remarks, while the ⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧ (straight man) reacts with sharp corrections. The annual M-1 Grand Prix is the most prestigious manzai competition in Japan.
